# Made-in-China.com

> > Made-in-China.com is a comprehensive B2B marketplace connecting global buyers with verified Chinese manufacturers and suppliers across industrial equipment, machinery, and consumer products.

Made-in-China.com serves as a major sourcing platform for wholesale manufacturers and industrial equipment from China, with extensive catalogs spanning agricultural machinery, plastic processing, metalworking, and specialized equipment. The platform integrates secured trading, online exhibitions, and factory directories to facilitate bulk procurement and B2B partnerships.

## Trading & Marketplace Platforms

- [Secured Trading Platform with High Quality Products and Reliable Manufacturers](https://trading.made-in-china.com): Secured B2B trading platform for bulk ordering from China manufacturers with verified suppliers and quality assurance
- [SMART EXPO | Online Exhibition on Made-in-China.com](https://expo.made-in-china.com/show): SMART EXPO online exhibition platform for B2B supplier matching and virtual trade shows
